{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overestimation bias.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true values show strong mean reversion or downward momentum.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if model shows premature spikes or overshoots after recent high prices.",
    "Apply upward bias correction if sentiment > 0.25 and true prices show sustained upward momentum.",
    "Cap forecast at 10% above recent 15-day high if sentiment is positive and price is trending upward.",
    "Use 30-day moving average as baseline for smoothing out short-term volatility in forecasts.",
    "If true outcome deviates > 10% from forecast, re-evaluate model’s sensitivity to sentiment shifts in prior 3 days."
  ]
}
